claim: Berkeley/DeepMind hexapod teacher policy training takes approximately 10 hours on an RTX TITAN GPU in IsaacGym, with student distillation taking an additional ~5 hours.
stance_target: hexapod skill learning requires 10-15 hours of total compute on a single high-end GPU
scope_conditions: SpiderPi hexapod, IsaacGym, RTX TITAN GPU, teacher-student framework, 3 separate skill policies

scope_conditions: Hexapod with depth camera + VIO, no real-time joint feedback

claim: The Berkeley hexapod paper employs curriculum training for all skills (stair climbing, obstacle avoidance, squeezing), gradually increasing difficulty.
stance_target: curriculum training is standard practice in legged robot skill learning
scope_conditions: IsaacGym, hexapod, 3 distinct tasks each with their own curriculum
